title: Analyzing Transformers in Embedding Space

layout.note: Three tall columns separated by dashed vertical rules, each with a bold title at top left. The left column stacks four rows (K, V, W_VO, W_QK) that each run left to right as a short pipeline ending in a token list. The centre column puts two model stacks around two pink bars, then a similarity matrix, a heat map and a matched matrix in a descending path joined by grey block arrows. The right column shows two model stacks, a big grey arrow to the stitched model, and a thought-bubble tail down to a lilac cloud with band-aid icons under it.

lesson: Show one operation applied to several targets by repeating the same small pipeline motif (vector, projection box, shared-space bar, readout) in aligned rows or columns, with real readouts as the payoff. Open up the one part whose inside needs explaining with a thought-bubble cloud, and keep one colour per model through the combined model.
